snippet.title: soulstation demo
snippet.description:
a visual novel between fear and love. Follow Kin as it falls deeper into a rusty world that will one day eat it whole. Will you get on board? 
~~~~~ demo out now
Kin and Clef lose themselves in The Station – an afterlife that rotates dreams into realities and a wish into a memory. What awaits them at the end of the spiral? Don't be afraid, don't be anything.

available on steam and itch !
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4370460/soulstation/
https://lemonblood.itch.io/soulstation

made by polygon cove
from Lemon+Blood
a place for you and me and the songs we sing;
